maya: quick summary — AB run for v3.2-int4 (long-doc cohort) finished. notable deltas vs baseline v3.2-fp16: MRR -2.8% (p=0.004), extraction-F1 -1.5%, hallucination rate +1.1pp, latency p95 +18ms. thinking automatic rollback rules need to be stricter for long-doc slices. :thinking_face:
igor: can you paste the slice breakdown? is this driven by a few tiny buckets or broad across prefixes?
maya: putting numbers — buckets by prefix_len: 0-128 (n=12k) MRR -0.6% ; 128-512 (n=8k) MRR -1.2% ; >512 (n=1.2k) MRR -4.6% (p=0.001). so worst hit is the long prefix bucket.
sarah: ugh long-docs again. proposal: require both a statistically significant MRR drop (p<0.01) AND either (a) absolute delta_mrr <= -1.0% on overall or (b) long-prefix delta <= -2.0% to trigger immediate rollback. otherwise stall progression and run targeted mitigations.
eli: also worried about small-n volatility on >512 bucket (only 1.2k). suggest bootstrap + minimum sample n>=500 and add a half-life smoothing window (3h) to avoid single-window noise.
maya: agree. here's a proposed canary config (for the rollout engine) — copy/paste: ```
canary_config:
  stages: [2, 10, 50, 100]
  hold_minutes: [30, 60, 120, 0]
  criteria:
    - name: mrr_global_stat_threshold
      test: "p_value < 0.01 and delta_mrr <= -1.0"
      action: rollback
    - name: longprefix_severe
      bucket: prefix_len_gt_512
      test: "p_value < 0.01 and delta_mrr <= -2.0 and n >= 500"
      action: rollback
    - name: hallucination_spike
      test: "delta_hallucination_pp >= 0.5"
      action: pause_and_notify
    - name: latency_tail
      test: "p95_delta_ms >= 40"
      action: pause
  hysteresis:
    sustained_windows: 2
    window_minutes: 45
  fallback_variant: "v3.2-fp16"
```
maya: note fallback_variant is the instant failover target. :white_check_mark:
igor: fine, but add token-position-weighted concordance as a soft gate (helps detect prefix truncation artifacts). we should query it like: `rwdctl metrics query --metric token_pos_concordance --buckets prefix_len>512` and weight later-token concordance higher.
sarah: rollout schedule + alerts: start at 2% -> 10 after 30m if green -> 50 after 1h -> 100. each stage requires no trigger hits and stable token_pos_concordance > 0.95 on long prefix bucket. ops alert to #eng-oncall if any pause/rollback. can we also add autorevert if composite criteria fire twice in a row?
maya: yes — add require sustained_windows=2 (45m each) before final rollback to reduce flip-flop. auto-revert if rollback criteria met in consecutive windows.
deploy-bot: [system] canary launch: v3.2-int4 -> 2% traffic at 1752461230. id=canary-2026-03-23-1752461230
eli: also adding a small grace buffer: if p<0.01 but delta_mrr between -1.0 and -1.5, do a targeted warmup of kv-cache for long docs and rerun a quick smoke cohort (10k requests) before escalating.
igor: +1 to cache warmup plan. add an instrumentation job: `jobs/run_prefix_warmup --model v3.2-int4 --buckets ">512" --samples 10000` and surface logs to the canary dashboard.
sarah: please tag the rollout with `rollout_tag: longdoc-int4-20260323` and update the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-longdocs — make sure the playbook includes manual rollback steps and contact list.
maya: will update runbook and add alerts to #eng-oncall and @sre. pushing the revised config now. thanks all. :pray:
igor: ping when alerts created and when warmup job finishes.
maya: will post results from the first hold window in this thread (ETA ~30m).
eli: :eyes:
sarah: thanks — this plan looks good to me.
